description: Utility functions for burn-on-read timer, including formatting time, calculating remaining time, warning and expiration checks, and ARIA accessibility announcements.

methods.name: formatTimeRemaining
methods.description: Formats milliseconds into HH:MM:SS or MM:SS format for countdown timer display.

methods.name: calculateRemainingTime
methods.description: Calculates remaining milliseconds from expiration timestamp, handling seconds/milliseconds inconsistency.

methods.name: isTimerInWarningState
methods.description: Checks if the timer is in warning state (≤ 1 minute remaining).

methods.name: isTimerExpired
methods.description: Checks if the timer has expired (remaining time ≤ 0).

methods.name: getAriaAnnouncementInterval
methods.description: Returns the interval in milliseconds for ARIA announcements based on remaining time.

methods.name: formatAriaAnnouncement
methods.description: Formats remaining time into a human-readable string for screen reader announcements.
